entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:1
segments: ¶Oh that you were my brother, who took milk from my mother's breasts! When I came to you in the street, I would give you kisses; yes, I would not be looked down on.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:2
segments: I would take you by the hand into my mother's house, and she would be my teacher. I would give you drink of spiced wine, drink of the pomegranate.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:3
segments: His left hand would be under my head, and his right hand about me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:4
segments: I say to you, O daughters of Jerusalem, do not let love be moved till it is ready.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:5
segments: ¶Who is this, who comes up from the waste places, resting on her loved one? It was I who made you awake under the apple-tree, where your mother gave you birth; there she was in pain at your birth.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:6
segments: Put me as a sign on your heart, as a sign on your arm; love is strong as death, and wrath bitter as the underworld: its coals are coals of fire; violent are its flames.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:7
segments: Much water may not put out love, or the deep waters overcome it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would be judged a price not great enough.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:8
segments: ¶We have a young sister, and she has no breasts; what are we to do for our sister in the day when she is given to a man?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:9
segments: If she is a wall, we will make on her a strong base of silver; and if she is a door, we will let her be shut up with cedar-wood.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:10
segments: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers; then was I in his eyes as one to whom good chance had come.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:11
segments: Solomon had a vine-garden at Baal-hamon; he let out the vine-garden to keepers; every one had to give a thousand bits of silver for its fruit.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:12
segments: My vine-garden, which is mine, is before me: you, O Solomon, will have the thousand, and those who keep the fruit of them two hundred.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:13
segments: ¶You who have your resting-place in the gardens, the friends give ear to your voice; make me give ear to it.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 8:14
segments: Come quickly, my loved one, and be like a roe on the mountains of spice.
